ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from sysobjects where name = 'TraPlat_DataRoz' and xtype = 'TR') drop trigger CDN.TraPlat_DataRoz;

create trigger CDN.TraPlat_DataRoz on CDN.TraPlat for insert, update as if not update(Trp_Pozostaje) return
declare @TrpTyp smallint declare @TrpNumer int declare @TrpLp smallint declare @TrpPozostaje decimal(15,2) declare @Tabela int
if @@ROWCOUNT = 1 begin select @TrpTyp=Trp_GIDTyp,@TrpNumer=Trp_GIDNumer,@TrpLp=Trp_GIDLp,@TrpPozostaje=Trp_Pozostaje from inserted; set @Tabela = CDN.GIDTyp2Tabela(@TrpTyp) if @Tabela=1 --tranag begin update cdn.tranag set trn_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where trn_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trn_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end if @Tabela = 10 --sadnag begin update cdn.sadnag set san_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where san_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and san_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end if @Tabela = 11 --impnag begin update cdn.impnag set imn_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where imn_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and imn_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end end; else begin declare rozrachunki_cur cursor local fast_forward for select Trp_GIDTyp,Trp_GIDNumer,Trp_GIDLp,Trp_Pozostaje from inserted; open rozrachunki_cur; fetch next from rozrachunki_cur into @TrpTyp, @TrpNumer, @TrpLp, @TrpPozostaje; while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin set @Tabela = CDN.GIDTyp2Tabela(@TrpTyp) if @Tabela=1 --tranag begin update cdn.tranag set trn_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where trn_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trn_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end if @Tabela = 10 --sadnag begin update cdn.sadnag set san_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where san_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and san_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end if @Tabela = 11 --impnag begin update cdn.impnag set imn_DataRoz= case when @TrpPozostaje<>0 then 0 else case when exists(select trp_gidnumer from cdn.traplat where trp_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and trp_gidnumer=@TrpNumer and trp_gidlp<>@TrpLp and trp_pozostaje<>0) then 0 else (select isnull(max(r2_datarozliczenia),0) from (select R2_Dok1Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok1Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok1Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia union all select R2_Dok2Typ as R2_DokTyp, R2_Dok2Numer as R2_DokNumer, R2_Dok2Lp as R2_DokLp, R2_DataRozliczenia from CDN.Rozliczenia ) as pod where R2_DokTyp = @TrpTyp and R2_DokNumer=@TrpNumer and R2_DokLp=@TrpLp) end end where imn_gidtyp=@TrpTyp and imn_gidnumer=@TrpNumer end
fetch next from rozrachunki_cur into @TrpTyp, @TrpNumer, @TrpLp, @TrpPozostaje; end close rozrachunki_cur; end;
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'TraPlat_AktualizujWydatkiPrcPlatnosci' AND type = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.TraPlat_AktualizujWydatkiPrcPlatnosci

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.TraPlat_AktualizujWydatkiPrcPlatnosci ON CDN.Traplat FOR DELETE AS BEGIN
UPDATE w set WPP_DokTRPTyp = 0 ,WPP_DokTRPFirma=0 ,WPP_DokTRPNumer=0 ,WPP_DokTRPLp=0 from deleted d join cdn.WydatkiPrcPlatnosci w on d.TrP_GIDTyp=w.WPP_DokTRPTyp and d.TrP_GIDNumer=w.WPP_DokTRPNumer and d.TrP_GIDLp=w.WPP_DokTRPLp
if @@ERROR<>0 begin rollback tran raiserror('#CDN_BLAD/##CDN_1=Błąd aktualizacji wydatku delegacji (1)/#',16,1) return end
if exists(select 1 from deleted where TrP_GIDTyp = 2984) begin UPDATE w set WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwTyp = 0 ,WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwFirma=0 ,WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwNumer=0 ,WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwLp=0 from deleted d join cdn.WydatkiPrcPlatnosci w on d.TrP_GIDTyp=w.WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwTyp and d.TrP_GIDNumer=w.WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwNumer and d.TrP_GIDLp=w.WPP_DLGTRPPrzeciwLp
if @@ERROR<>0 begin rollback tran raiserror('#CDN_BLAD/##CDN_1=Błąd aktualizacji wydatku delegacji (2)/#',16,1) return end end END
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'TraPlat_AktualizujProlZrdGID' AND type = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.TraPlat_AktualizujProlZrdGID

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.TraPlat_AktualizujProlZrdGID ON CDN.Traplat FOR INSERT AS BEGIN UPDATE trp SET trp.TrP_ProlZrdTyp=trp.TrP_GidTyp, trp.TrP_ProlZrdFirma=trp.Trp_GidFirma, trp.TrP_ProlZrdNumer=trp.Trp_GidNumer, trp.TrP_ProlZrdLp = trp.TrP_GidLp FROM cdn.traplat AS trp INNER JOIN inserted i ON i.trp_gidtyp = trp.TrP_GIDTyp and i.trp_gidNumer = trp.TrP_GIDNumer and i.TrP_GIDFirma = trp.TrP_GIDFirma and i.trp_gidLp = trp.TrP_GIDLp WHERE i.TrP_ProlZrdNumer=0
if @@ERROR<>0 begin rollback tran raiserror('#CDN_BLAD/##CDN_1=Błąd aktualizacji TrP_ProlZrodlGID(1)/#',16,1) return END END
